items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: No, no special, all I did was I played for the show and when they were short a chorus girl I'd go up on the stage and dance.

ctx.x: When you went out with the Harris show were you just part of the band or did you have a special spot of your own?

No, no special, all I did was I played for the show and when they were short a chorus girl I'd go up on the stage and dance. I never did a solo but we did a combo. You know that was during the era in the 20's of the jazz band, you know, small combos and all they did was clown. A lot of music was coming out of the horns but there was a lot of clowning. That was the jazz band era...
